reason: The surgical cut-mode recheck adds five isolated, tested runtime policy modules: spoken-audio Factory execution, fail-closed legacy ENG/cache replay source handling, Telegram-accepted cached replay delivery evidence, a no-downgrade exact-boundary policy, and maximum-quality Factory source acquisition. The no-downgrade module adds one narrowly scoped canonical Gemini-model regex with dedicated regression tests; the source module adds no regex or editorial postprocess debt.

evidence.quality_contract: Factory selects Russian versus Yandex LiveDub only after Gemini has heard the audio; unknown language fails closed; every proven non-Russian language requires LiveDub; partial Telegram delivery is reported truthfully; legacy ENG cuts cannot silently render the untranslated original; valid analysis cache becomes a no-publication replay; only Telegram-accepted cut videos count as replay success; Gemini must be canonical Pro >=3.1; Whisper must be exact large-v3; configured quality, timing, disk and timeout floors cannot be lowered; fractional Gemini boundaries survive validation; Factory rendering cannot perform a second silence-snap after the final boundary audit; final files are capped from their real probes; Russian render sources use bestvideo+bestaudio without a 720p/container preference; and Gemini audio uses the best native stream, codec-copy remux for supported codecs or lossless FLAC after decoding unsupported Opus/other codecs rather than an intermediate MP3 generation.

regex_evidence.purpose: Validate canonical gemini-<version>-pro model identifiers and reject aliases that merely contain the word pro.

source_quality_evidence.policy: Reset prior yt-dlp format sorting, select bestvideo+bestaudio/best with no resolution ceiling, download bestaudio/best without yt-dlp MP3 extraction, probe every source, remux AAC/MP3/Vorbis/FLAC without re-encoding, convert unsupported codecs to lossless FLAC, and pass the prepared file's real supported MIME into all three Gemini passes.
